conventions.frame: UTM zone 37N minus the first valid GNSS fix of the run
conventions.z: altitude minus origin altitude, m -- NOTE the jury said z is a height; whether they subtract the start altitude or compare absolute is not resolved, this file uses relative
conventions.t: seconds from the first sample of the run

note: Scoring target, not an input. The vehicle spends part of the run outside the mapped corridor (depot), where the route offers no constraint; on_route marks which rows that is.
